notes: NSW run 1. Not covered: regional towns (Coffs Harbour, Port Macquarie, Byron, Tamworth, Orange, Wagga, Albury, Dubbo) - searches returned only aggregators, no clinic own pages opened. Not opened: ARH Baulkham Hills, ARH Greater Western Sydney (Minchinbury), SASH Rosebery/other referral pages, nevs.net.au, vsos.com.au (provenance refused), AVA and NSW VPB pages. Other Australian states not covered. NSW run 2: added 42 entries (ARH Baulkham Hills and Minchinbury, regional clinics from their own sites in Coffs Harbour, Port Macquarie, Tamworth, Orange, Bathurst, Wagga Wagga, Albury, Dubbo, Armidale, Byron/Bangalow, Ballina, Lismore, Nowra, Queanbeyan, Murwillumbah, Taree, Newcastle/Lake Macquarie). Not covered: SASH Rosebery (no such SASH location on sashvets.com/about-sash), Pacific Vet Care Coffs Harbour, Vet on Bathurst, Taree Veterinary Hospital, River Country AEC, Moorong Vet Wagga, vetwagga.com.au, Nowra Veterinary Hospital (robots_disallowed or fetch errors twice), Grafton, Kempsey, Tweed Heads, Maitland/Cessnock, Moree, Broken Hill, Goulburn, Cooma, and the AVA / NSW VPB pages (no emergency list found). Other Australian states not covered. Victoria run: added 52 entries (14 with a page explicitly stating 24 h: AES Hawthorn East, ARH Essendon Fields, CARE Collingwood, AEC Mount Waverley/Moorabbin/Frankston, VRH Dandenong, Greencross Vet Hospital Werribee, Peninsula Vet Emergency Mornington, Northern Suburbs Bundoora, Casey Pet Emergency, Southpaws Malvern, MASH Ringwood, Advanced Vetcare Kensington). Geelong Animal Emergency (own site gives evening/weekend hours, not 24 h), Gippsland Pet Emergency (Fri 6pm-Mon 8am + holidays) and phone on-call services are emergency_24h=false. Not opened / blocked: advancedvetcare.com.au contact and Kew pages (robots_disallowed; Kew phone 9020 3555 only on third-party pages), animaldoc.com.au Inverloch (robots), lsvc.com.au Warrnambool (robots), geelongvet.com.au and gippsvet.com.au (fetch errors), wonthaggivet.com.au, penvetcare.com.au emergency page, Wangaratta Veterinary Clinic (redirect loop), Fur Life Vet Shepparton (site redirects to apiam.com.au), Mornington Peninsula Sorrento/Flinders, MVSC (specialist, not 24 h), RSPCA Victoria, AVA and Veterinary Practitioners Registration Board Victoria pages (no emergency list opened). Not covered: Shepparton, Lorne, Mt Buller/Falls Creek, Pakenham, Sunbury, Craigieburn, Hamilton, Wonthaggi/Leongatha, Mildura second clinics, Kew Advanced Vetcare. University of Melbourne Parkville has no small-animal hospital page found; Werribee hospital is run by Greencross.
